minValues.description:
Minimum number of non-missing values in window for the final computed result for the window to have a value.
Otherwise, the final result for the window is null or NaN.  "Non-missing value" here refers to an
individual element field, not the entire element.

title:
@inheritdoc CollectionWindow

This subType is for operations on an expanding window.
For a general description and examples of what is an expanding window operation, see
[pandas.DataFrame.expanding](https://pandas.pydata.org/pandas-docs/stable/reference/api/pandas.DataFrame.expanding.html)

@var C
        Collection Type. To be able to return the same Type after doing the subsequent operation.
        (e.g.: If the collection which this operation is acting on is a DataTable, the output of the `agg` function
        should also be a DataTable.)
name: CollectionExpanding
